## Evidence and interpretation

The neural study uses one fixed medium, k in [1,2], 1000 frequency groups and eight directions per group. Train/validation/test contain 5360/1360/1280 fields. Mean consistent complex FEM L2 errors: SNO v2 0.9475%, FNO 1.6599%, Chebyshev-SNO 7.9364%. POD and normalization use train; checkpoint/rank selection uses validation. These are FEM-label errors for held-out wave parameters, not new-material or continuum-PDE accuracy. Model sizes and devices differ.

GMsFEM has separate saved studies: [notebook material](gmsfem/results/notebook/report.md), [paper-inspired material](gmsfem/results/paper_example1/report.md). Do not merge these material presets with neural metrics.

Datasets and model bundles are local ignored artifacts. Obsolete neural experiment results were removed entirely from the current project tree; do not reconstruct their claims from old references. Preserve true current metrics and distinguish representation, interpolation, prediction and FEM discretization errors.
